</p><p class="western" style="break-before: page; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; page-break-before: always; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(tōu liáng huàn zhù)</span></p>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Replace the Beams with Rotten Timbers</i></span></p><br>
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">The opportunity to interfere with an opponent's formations, methods of
operation, or even to change the rules by which they engage, should
never be forgone.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
In 383 A.D. the states of Former Qin and Jin faced each other from
opposite sides of the Fei River. Neither could advance, as trying to
cross would make them vulnerable. Xie Xuan (<span><span lang="zh-CN">謝玄</span></span>,
343-388 A.D.), the general of Jin, sent a messenger to Fu Rong (<span><span lang="zh-CN">苻融</span></span>,
died 383 A.D.), the general of Former Qin, suggesting that the Former
Qin forces retreat slightly west to allow for the Jin troops to
cross. Fu Rong agreed, while actually planning to double back and
attack them while they crossed. Meanwhile, Jin troops were
infiltrating the ranks of the Former Qin, spreading rumors that
Former Qin was retreating in the face of a powerful attack. The
Former Qin troops then panicked and fled, turning a planned attack
into a rout [20].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="font-style: normal;"><span style="font-weight: normal;">Battle
formations in ancient China were often described as having two </span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">axles
-- one horizontal and earthly, and one vertical and heavenly [1]. By
manipulating these support structures, formations could be made to
lose their integrity.</span><br><br>
<i>Replace
the Beams with Rotten Timbers</i>
is associated with the 64th hexagram, <i>Fire
over Water</i>. The
yang lines here can be viewed as the axles of a cart. As Fire is
moves upward, and Water downward, the lower axle here risks being
bogged down or stuck, a vulnerability which might well be used
against one's opponent [1],
[28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">


</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<div dir="ltr" id="Section77" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你的香水很好闻。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">Trans.: Your perfume smells

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) I. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">把我的皮带和围巾带给我，可以吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">II.
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">它们在哪？</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">III.
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">在我的行李袋里。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">3) </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">这些年轻人是国家的栋梁。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">4)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">这个柱子好像不太直。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我需要一个新的空调遥控器，什么地</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;方的价格最合理？</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">在小山上，有一个小店卖的遥控器不</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;贵。</span></span></span></span></p>

    <span style="color: #0047AB !important;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;换了他。</span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">别推你的弟弟。</span></span></span></p>

	8) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他们为什么吵架？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">饭店让他付面纸的钱，但是他说没有</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;用面纸。</span></span></span></span></span></div>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你在看什么书？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">是一本关于杀手的书。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">要刷油漆的话，需要一些质量好的刷子。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-target-text5"></a></span>
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">11</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">)</span></span>
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">如果想当律师，你应该学怎么争论。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
